title: MV Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'naturalWidth' of null

posts.author: GrentoYTP
posts.body:
Hello.
I've had a problem for a while now;
I created a common event, which consists of playing a short animation (video) of an attack or parry using the PDK_VPlayer plugin by Pheonix KageDesu. It plays videos in WEBM format. I noticed that every time the video ends, there is a chance that the error will appear. I think that this is because the game is trying to read some data from the video that has already been removed from the cache. Maybe the whole thing is not 100% optimized, so sometimes it will load everything on time and sometimes not. After the animation ends, an image of a "static sword" appears, which is held in such a way that it does not disappear immediately after the attack animation. Below I am sending more data from the console.
Please help me fix this error. I haven't found any solution. Thanks in advance for your help!

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
what does the attack and parry look like?
why not use animation on them?
Vplayer is to use to interact with, not exactly used for animation alike.
if you want to use attacking animations, parrying as playable, I would look
into PDK_AnimaX plugin instead for attacking.
else look into animation to be played instead.
Galv_Projectiles does this really good if you aiming for an lightweight abs system.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
best way to make it nice is calling an common event.
Code:
if slash is ON (no interaction possible)
    picture 1 = slash_1 ..... 
    wait 4
    picture 1 = slash_2....
    wait 4
    picture 1 = slash 6
    wait 20 frames
    switch Slash is OFF
else
    slash switch = ON
end
something like this (use it for each weapon if different animation.
but its a matter of testing though what works best.
